stem:
Two plant species that grow in the same area are shown.

Which statement best explains a difference between Plant 1 and Plant 2?

options.label: A
options.text: Plant 1 obtains more water from the soil because of its root surface area and root depth.

options.label: B
options.text: Plant 1 obtains more sunlight because of its root surface area and root depth.

options.label: C
options.text: Plant 2 obtains more water from the soil because of its root surface area and root depth.

options.label: D
options.text: Plant 2 obtains more sunlight because of its root surface area and root depth.

visual_elements: Two drawn plants, labeled Plant 1 and Plant 2, showing different root surface areas and depths.
